name: Arcana Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (arcana) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Arcane Deduction (Ex)

You can use inspiration for free with the Use Magic Device skill. If you roll a natural 1 when attempting to activate a magic item, you can expend 2 points from your inspiration pool to ignore the automatic failure and 24-hour delay this normally causes, although any other consequences of failure remain.

Associated Technique
Disruptive Technique (Ex)

While you employ this technique against an opponent you threaten and have studied, the DC for that opponent to cast spells defensively increases by 1. At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the DC further increases by 1, to a maximum increase of +6 to the DC at 20th level. You only apply this penalty to a spellcaster if you are aware of the enemy’s location and capable of taking an attack of opportunity.

Advanced Study Abilities
Amateur Spellcaster I

Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 10, Arcane Deduction study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You acquire a vague understanding of arcane magic and can prepare a limited number of arcane spells per day. You keep a spell book as a wizard, which automatically contains read magic and 3 additional cantrips (0-level spell) of your choice from the sorcerer/wizard spell list to add to your spellbook. All 0-level sorcerer/wizard spells are considered to be on your spell list. You can add additional cantrips to your spellbook following the same process that a wizard would follow. You can prepare one cantrip per day, plus one additional cantrip for every 4 ranks you possess in Knowledge (arcana). Each morning, you can prepare these cantrips just as a wizard, doing so at the same time that you study your scholar notebook. Casting any prepared cantrip requires the expenditure of 1 point of inspiration. Your caster level for these spells is equal to your ranks in Knowledge (arcana), and the DC for a saving throw against any of them is 10 + the spell level + your Intelligence modifier.

Amateur Spellcaster II

Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 12, Amateur Spellcaster I study ability, scholar level 3rd.

You learn one 1st-level spell to add to your spellbook, gain one 1st-level spell slot, and all 1st-level sorcerer/wizard spells are considered to be on your spell list. At 6th level, you add one 2nd-level spell to your spellbook, gain one 2nd-level spell slot, and all 2nd-level sorcerer/wizard spells are considered to be on your spell list. You gain additional 1st-level spell slots when you reach 8 and 13 ranks in Knowledge (arcana).

You do not gain bonus spell slots for high ability scores. Each morning, you prepare spells in these slots, just as a wizard. Casting any prepared cantrip no longer requires inspiration, but casting a 1st- or 2nd-level spell requires the expenditure of 1 point of 7 inspiration (in addition to the appropriate 1st- or 2nd-level spell slot). This otherwise follows the rules for the Amateur Spellcaster I study ability.

Amateur Spellcaster III

Prerequisite(s): Intelligence 14, Amateur Spellcaster II study ability scholar level 9th.

You add one 3rd-level spell to your spellbook, gain one 3rd-level spell slot, and all 3rd-level sorcerer/wizard spells are considered to be on your spell list. When you reach 12 ranks in Knowledge (arcana), you gain an additional 2nd-level spell slot.

When you reach 15 ranks in Knowledge (arcana), you add one 4th-level spell to your spellbook, gain one 4th-level spell slot, and all 4th-level sorcerer/wizard spells are considered to be on your spell list. Casting any prepared 1st- or 2nd-level spell no longer requires inspiration, but casting a 3rd- or 4th-level spell requires the expenditure of 1 point of inspiration (in addition to the appropriate spell slot). This otherwise follows the rules for the Amateur Spellcaster I study ability.

Scholarly Artifice (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Arcane Deduction study ability scholar level 3rd.

Having unlocked the secrets of arcane knowledge, you are able emulate many of the tricks of ordinary spellcasters in place of more ordinary spells. You gain your choice of either Craft Magic Arms and Armor or Craft Wondrous Item as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. You can use your scholar level as your caster level when qualifying for further Craft Item feats, and you substitute your ranks in Knowledge (arcana) as your caster level when using those feats. In order to create a spell trigger or spell completion item, your ranks in Knowledge (arcana) must be at least double the minimum spell level required. When attempting to create a magical item for which you do not possess a prerequisite spell, you can attempt to replicate the spell by means of artful experimentation, using a Knowledge (arcana) check (DC 15 + the level of the spell being replicated); you may use inspiration on this check. If successful, you can create the item as if you had cast the prerequisite spell. You must possess any material components necessary for casting the spell that you are replicating. If the item being created requires multiple spells, you must make this check for each spell you intend to replicate. If you fail the skill check, you may not try again for that spell while creating that item—the item creation DC increases as normal for the creation of an item without a prerequisite spell in such a case.
